summary: Tested Merchant Testimonials system end-to-end: 10 pytest backend tests (public list/filter, admin auth, CRUD, validation, toggle-via-update hides from public) + Playwright frontend checks on /merchant-landing public section and /admin/old AdminTestimonialsTab. All scenarios from review request pass.

minor.issue: Response shape is {testimonials, count} — no explicit ok:true field as described in request wording. Not a functional bug; public consumer (MerchantTestimonials.jsx) reads testimonials array correctly.

issues: On first card (Pizzeria Da Mario) with business name wrapping, the Location chip 'Berlin-Kreuzberg' can visually overflow to the right outside card bounds at ~1280px; similar clipping visible on Hair & Style card ('München') and FitZone ('Köln'). Consider flex-wrap or truncate on location span in MerchantTestimonials.jsx meta row.

action_items: Optional: normalize public /api/testimonials response to include ok:true for consistency with admin endpoints (currently only returns {testimonials, count}).
Minor design polish: prevent location badge overflow in MerchantTestimonials card meta row (wrap/truncate).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/testimonials.py uses @router.on_event('startup') — deprecated in FastAPI in favor of lifespan handlers. Works but emits DeprecationWarning. Consider moving seed into server.py lifespan.
PUT /admin/{id} accepts raw dict without Pydantic validation — any unknown fields are persisted. Consider TestimonialUpdate Pydantic model with optional fields.
AdminTestimonialsTab.jsx: save() does not re-validate business_name emptiness before POST; server-side Pydantic catches it (422) but UX could show inline error earlier.
MerchantTestimonials.jsx falls back silently on fetch error (catch noop). Consider a small error state for debugging.
seed_data_creation: No seed creation needed; backend auto-seeds 4 testimonials on startup when collection is empty. Create test produced one TEST_ row which was deleted in the same test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testimonials CRUD + public list verified. Seed items are Pizzeria Da Mario (gastro), Hair & Style Studio (service), BioBack Bäckerei (bakery), FitZone Studio (fitness). Admin cookie-based auth via POST /api/auth/login works without 2FA for admin@bidblitz.com. Frontend admin route is /admin/old, tab id='testimonials'. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_testimonials.py.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects; all 10 backend tests and all frontend checks (public section + admin tab + Neu/Edit/Toggle) passed.
